note: Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-08-01 (cross-family corroborated). Biscuit (`biscuit`, RL B2 Supporter Electric, ammo 6 / chargeFrames 60 / reloadFrames 141): a support unit with NO damage line of her own — her kit is two CLASS-SCOPED buffs plus two CLASS-SCOPED heals, all keyed off the team rotation. S1 ('Activates at the END of Full Burst', all ATTACKER allies) = (B1) critRateNormalPct ▲5.77% for 10s + (B2) a heal-over-time (ticks:10, intervalSec:1) on trigger fullBurstEnd (the literal 'end of Full Burst', NOT fullBurstEnter — the 10s window opens as the FB window CLOSES), target alliesOfClass Attacker. critRateNormalPct is the normal-attack-scoped crit stat (helm S1 carrier; sim.ts joins it to the roll ONLY on normal-attack hits, so skill/burst buckets are untouched). Burst ('Walk Training', all SUPPORTER allies) = (B6) atkPct ▲43.08% for 10s + (B7) a lifesteal-over-time heal (ticks:10, intervalSec:1) on trigger burstCast, target alliesOfClass Supporter (reaches the other Supporter allies AND herself). THE TWO HEALS ARE MODELED as `heal` effects (NOT dropped), per the helm precedent (helm's burst 'recovers 54.45% of attack damage as HP for 10 sec' is a heal ticks:10 intervalSec:1 that drives recovery consumers — scripts/tests/units/helm.test.ts H8) and the independent blind re-derivation (claude-fable-5 S2b converged on the recovery-stream encoding for both lines). A `heal` emits recovery events to its targets and fires THEIR 'recovery'-triggered blocks; the engine models no HP AMOUNT, so the heal's only sim content is that recovery channel. CRITICAL SCOPE GUARD: both heals are class-scoped (S1→Attacker, burst→Supporter) and so do NOT feed a DEFENDER recovery consumer — Crown's S2 'when recovery takes effect → team ATK ▲20.99%' is the canonical consumer and is a Defender, exactly the class biscuit's heals exclude. This is the inverse of the liter cover-HP trap (owner ruling 2026-07-21): liter's cover-restore was dropped because cover-HP is NOT a unit heal and was spuriously firing Crown; biscuit's lines ARE genuine unit heals but are scoped AWAY from Defenders, so they fire only matching-class consumers (e.g. asuka, an Attacker 'on-recovery → self ATK ▲96.98%' carrier, fed by S1) and never Crown. S2 ('when a Defender ally's HP falls below 50%') stays UNMODELED: v1 has no HP pool / damage-taken model (immortal boss), so the HP-threshold trigger is indeterminate and can never legitimately fire — both the invincibility and the 23.26% heal share that un-fireable trigger (fable concurred). The burst cover-rebuild stays UNMODELED (cover has no sim representation; same NO-OP class as liter S2). PINNED END-TO-END by scripts/tests/units/biscuit.test.ts: B1/B6 buff scoping is discriminated on the CLASS axis (all-allies counterfactual reaches the whole team; shipped reaches exactly the 2 Attackers / 2 Supporters) and, for B1, the NORMAL-SCOPE axis (generic critRatePct moves skill/burst crit; shipped is byte-identical to buff-removed there); B2/B7 heal scoping is discriminated with asuka as an Attacker recovery probe (S1 HoT feeds asuka's self-ATK recovery buff; the burst lifesteal does NOT — proven by isolating each heal) and a Crown negative (neither heal feeds the Defender consumer — the liter-trap guard).

skill1: Constantly recovers 1.53% of the skill user's final Max HP every 1 sec for 10 sec. — magnitude only: the HP amount has no engine consumer (no HP pool), so the number is unmodeled; the recovery EVENT is modeled (heal, skill1/burst slots), which is the board-relevant half — on-recovery consumers read the event, never the amount.
skill2: Invincible for 5 sec. Activates 2 time(s) per battle. — UNMODELED (inert): defensive invincibility on a Defender ally whose HP falls below 50%; v1 has no damage-taken / HP-threshold model (immortal boss), so the trigger is indeterminate and can never legitimately fire. No invincibility primitive exists in the schema.

Recovers 23.26% of the skill user's final Max HP. Activates 2 time(s) per battle. — UNMODELED (inert): a genuine unit heal, BUT it shares skill2's un-fireable HP-below-50% trigger (no HP pool in v1), so it can never legitimately fire either. NOT encoded on an invented proxy trigger — doing so would spuriously drive a Defender ally's on-recovery kit (Crown-class over-credit); the faithful disposition is UNMODELED + verbatim record.
burst: Affects 2 random ally unit(s) whose cover has been destroyed. Rebuild Cover with 93.6% HP. — UNMODELED (inert): restores COVER HP, not a unit's HP; no sim cover-HP representation (same NO-OP class as liter S2, owner ruling 2026-07-21). Emits no unit-recovery event, so it must not trigger recovery-consumer teammates.

Recovers 55.44% of attack damage as HP over 10 sec. — magnitude only: the HP amount has no engine consumer (no HP pool), so the number is unmodeled; the recovery EVENT is modeled (heal, skill1/burst slots), which is the board-relevant half — on-recovery consumers read the event, never the amount.

caveats: skill1: trigger is fullBurstEnd (the literal 'at the end of Full Burst') — the 10s window opens as the FB window closes, NOT on FB entry. Both effects are Attacker-class-scoped (alliesOfClass Attacker), so biscuit herself (a Supporter) receives neither.

skill1: the heal-over-time IS modeled (heal ticks:10 intervalSec:1) as an Attacker-scoped recovery stream — it feeds Attacker 'on-recovery' consumers (e.g. asuka) but, being Attacker-scoped, never the Defender consumer Crown.

burst: ATK buff AND lifesteal heal are Supporter-class-scoped (alliesOfClass Supporter), reaching biscuit herself plus any other Supporter. The lifesteal is a Supporter recovery stream; no Supporter 'on-recovery' consumer exists in the current roster, so the channel is faithfully encoded but presently inert (it does NOT feed the Attacker probe asuka, nor the Defender Crown).
burst: the cover-rebuild line is an inert NO-OP in v1 (no cover representation).

weapon: biscuit's own RL damage is minor relative to her support value; the base-weapon cadence is datamined (rate_of_fire 60, reloadFrames 141, chargeFrames 60) and unverified by footage — read rounds/min + reload gap from a focus video if her self-damage ever matters.
